1. Technical Specifications The Wrist Watch GPS offered by the bidder shall comply with the following minimum technical specification s: (a) Make/Model: Garmin Foretrex 801. (b) Dimensions: 2.9" × 1.9" × 0.9". (c) Weight: 87.3 g (with batteries). (d) Display: Monochrome MIP, sunlight readable and compatible with Night Vision Goggles. (e) Display Size: 2.2" diagonal with resolution of 320 × 240 pixels. (f) Waterproofing: IPX7. (g) Battery Life: Up to 100 hours in standard GPS mode. (h) GPS: Multi-band GNSS supporting GPS, GLONASS and Galileo. (j) Compass: Tilt-compensated 3-axis compass. (k) Sensors: 3-axis accelerometer and barometric altimeter. (l) Route Storage: Up to 50 reversible routes. (m) Track Log: Storage of up to 100 active tracks. (n) Data Transfer: USB Type-C port for charging and data transfer. 2. Warranty. The product shall carry a comprehensive warranty of minimum two years from the date of a cceptance by the consignee. 3. OEM Authorisation. Non-submission or non-compliance shall rend er the bid liable for rejection. 5. Make and Model. Supply shall be strictly limited to Garmin Foretrex 801. No alternate make/model sh all be accepted. 6.
